steps: Use espresso machine to brew strong robusta coffee shots.
Allow coffee to cool slightly before handling.
Whip cream and condensed milk in mixer until soft peaks form.
Fold in a pinch of sea salt for savory balance.
Pour cooled coffee into serving glass.
Gently spoon salted foam on top to create layers.

plan.caption: We are bringing back the classic Vietnamese sea salt coffee to Block 216 Dessert Café. We brew strong robusta shots and top them with a thick, lightly sweetened foam made with cream, condensed milk, and a touch of sea salt. It balances the bitterness of the coffee with a creamy, savory finish. Perfect with our pistachio latte or butter croissant. Come try the new addition to our drink menu. #seaSaltCoffee #SingaporeEats
plan.offer: Buy any dessert and get the Sea Salt Coffee at half price this launch week.
